senses.gloss: (b. h.; √אף , v. אפף) [to heat, darken, cmp. חמץ,] to bake.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">Keth. V, 5</cite> <he>ואוֹפָה</he> and must bake.
Pes. 116ᵃ. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ bot. א׳ ג׳ תנורים baked three ovenfulls of bread; a. fr.—Part. pass. אָפוּי baked, (as a noun) pastry.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> <he>א׳ אחד וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="P01059"><he>עפוי</he></cite>; Pesik. Eth Korb. p. 58ᵇ, Yalk. Num. 777 <cite ref="U00074"><he>שבוי</he></cite> corr. acc.) I charged thee with the furnishing of one kind of pastry (to supply the governor’s household).—Pl. <he>אֲפוּיִים</he>. Mekh. Bs’hall. Vay. 4.—Fem. <he>אֲפוּיָה</he>.
Gen. R. s. 67 (play on epho, Gen. XXVII, 37) פתך א׳ thy bread is baked, thou shalt have to eat without labor.
<cite ref="Genesis 27:37">Ib.</cite> <he>פורניתא א׳</he> (read <he>פורניתך</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00366"><he>פּורָנִית</he></cite> a. <cite ref="Q00362"><he>פּוֹרְנִי</he></cite>.
Cant. R. to IV, 11 (play on epho, v. supra) מי נ׳ בתנור זה who is to be baked in this oven (hell)?—

senses.gloss: <cite ref="A02666">same</cite>. Mekh. l. c. <he>היה מִתְאַפֶּה</he> became baked of itself.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 89:1">Sifré Num. 89</cite> <he>המתְאַפִּים בתנור</he> things baked in the oven.
